name: @seg/lint
description: ESLint toolchain. typescript-eslint needs the TypeScript JS API (<6.1); the repo's tsc is TypeScript 7 (native, no JS API). This package pins TS 6 for the linter only. It is its own install root (not an npm workspace, which would hoist ts-api-utils next to TS 7); the root postinstall runs `npm ci --prefix tools/lint`.
